UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private user account profile for PulseEPG storing display name, email, subscription tier (free or pro), and timestamps.

displayName.description: User display name shown in the PulseEPG header

email.description: User email address (PII isolated to owner)

plan.description: Subscription tier: free (Gratuit) or pro (PulseEPG Pro)

isPremium.description: Whether the user has active PulseEPG Pro status

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last profile update

UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: Synchronized user preferences (user_id, selected_bouquets, favorite_channels, is_premium) for multi-device EPG sync (e.g. Samsung TV, Android TV, Smartphone).

selected_bouquets.description: List of selected satellite bouquet IDs (max 3 when is_premium is false, up to 25 when is_premium is true)

favorite_channels.description: List of favorite channel XMLTV IDs synchronized across devices (bounded <= 200)

is_premium.description: Whether the user has PulseEPG Pro unlimited bouquets enabled

created_at.description: Server timestamp of initial settings sync

updated_at.description: Server timestamp of latest settings sync

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-isolated user profile document for PulseEPG accounts

/user_settings/{userId}.description: Owner-isolated user_settings document synchronizing selected_bouquets and favorite_channels across devices
